_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "repertoires" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NOT NULL, "pgn" TEXT NOT NULL, "pgn_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "last_trained_at" INTEGER NULL, "drill_start_from" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'move1', "last_mode" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "nodes" ("repertoire_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "node_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "parent_id" INTEGER NULL, "ply" INTEGER NOT NULL, "san" TEXT NULL, "uci" TEXT NULL, "fen" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_user_move" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_user_move" IN (0, 1)), "child_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "why" TEXT NULL, "plan" TEXT NULL, "watch" TEXT NULL, "alt" TEXT NULL, "shapes" TEXT NULL, "raw_comment" TEXT NULL, "nags" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("repertoire_id", "node_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lines" ("repertoire_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "line_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "leaf_node_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ordinal" INTEGER NOT NULL, "plies" INTEGER NOT NULL, "user_move_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "branch_ply" INTEGER NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "ucis" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("repertoire_id", "line_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "runs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "repertoire_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "line_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "ucis" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_ply" INTEGER NOT NULL, "wrong_move_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "finished_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "local_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("completed" IN (0, 1)), "deviated" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("deviated" IN (0, 1)), "graded_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "credit_sum" REAL NOT NULL, "hint_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "schema" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "move_grades" ("run_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ply" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expected" TEXT NOT NULL, "accepted" TEXT NOT NULL, "first_attempt" TEXT NULL, "result" TEXT NOT NULL, "credit" REAL NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL, "hint_level" INTEGER NOT NULL, "check_cp" INTEGER NULL, "check_status" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("run_id", "ply"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "deviation_events" ("run_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ply" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deviation_uci" TEXT NULL, "reply_uci" TEXT NULL, "best_uci" TEXT NOT NULL, "loss_cp" INTEGER NULL, "passed" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("passed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("run_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "line_stats" ("repertoire_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "line_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "run_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "accuracy" REAL NULL, "last_played_at" INTEGER NULL, "in_weak_pool" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("in_weak_pool" IN (0, 1)), "weak_clean_streak" INTEGER NOT NULL, "srs_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "srs_reps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "srs_ease" REAL NOT NULL, "srs_interval_days" INTEGER NOT NULL, "srs_due_day" TEXT NULL, "srs_lapses" INTEGER NOT NULL, "srs_first_seen_day" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("repertoire_id", "line_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ply_stats" ("repertoire_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ucis" TEXT NOT NULL, "ply" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL, "misses" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("repertoire_id", "ucis", "ply"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "imported_games" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "username" TEXT NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_time" INTEGER NOT NULL, "time_class" TEXT NOT NULL, "time_control" TEXT NOT NULL, "rated" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("rated" IN (0, 1)), "user_white" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("user_white" IN (0, 1)), "result" TEXT NOT NULL, "result_detail" TEXT NOT NULL, "white_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "black_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "white_rating" INTEGER NOT NULL, "black_rating" INTEGER NOT NULL, "eco" TEXT NULL, "opening" TEXT NULL, "ucis" TEXT NOT NULL, "sans" TEXT NOT NULL, "clocks" TEXT NULL, "pgn" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "game_archives" ("username" TEXT NOT NULL, "archive" TEXT NOT NULL, "etag" TEXT NULL, "last_modified" TEXT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("username", "archive"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "game_reviews" ("game_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile" INTEGER NOT NULL, "engine" TEXT NOT NULL, "analysed" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "complete" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("complete" IN (0, 1)), "white_accuracy" REAL NULL, "black_accuracy" REAL NULL, "white_performance" INTEGER NULL, "black_performance" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("game_id", "profile"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "game_analysis" ("game_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ply" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cp" INTEGER NULL, "mate" INTEGER NULL, "pv" TEXT NULL, "depth" INTEGER NOT NULL, "capped" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("capped" IN (0, 1)), "second_cp" INTEGER NULL, "second_mate" INTEGER NULL, "label" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("game_id", "profile", "ply"));
CREATE INDEX lines_by_ordinal ON lines (repertoire_id, ordinal)
CREATE INDEX runs_by_line ON runs (repertoire_id, line_key, finished_at)
CREATE INDEX runs_by_day ON runs (local_day)
CREATE INDEX runs_by_synced ON runs (synced_at)
CREATE INDEX runs_daily_stats ON runs (repertoire_id, completed, local_day, graded_count, credit_sum)
CREATE INDEX runs_key_ucis ON runs (repertoire_id, line_key, ucis)
CREATE INDEX games_by_user ON imported_games (username, end_time)
